subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: Should discovery silently skip oversized hook metadata, or emit an operator-visible warning while remaining fail-soft?
rationale: The memory bound is justified, but current behavior and documentation do not establish silent hook disappearance as the intended compatibility and recovery policy.

options.title: Warn and skip
options.body: Keep discovery fail-soft while logging the oversized package.json or HOOK.md path and size limit.

options.title: Silently skip
options.body: Treat oversized metadata like other invalid hook input without an operator-visible diagnostic.

recommendation.title: Warn and skip
recommendation.body: Keep discovery fail-soft while logging the oversized package.json or HOOK.md path and size limit.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced both the affected discovery implementation and its canonical shared descriptor helper.
